title: The Rosicrucian Enlightenment and the Invisible College

tellings.quote: There's a great um book called the Rosacrushian Enlightenment.

plain: Michels holds that the Rosicrucians, a secretive mystical movement in early modern Europe, fed into the Invisible College, a circle of early English scientists that included the chemist Robert Boyle. He brings it up himself, in a talk with the Pentagon whistleblower Matthew Brown, by recommending The Rosicrucian Enlightenment, a book by the historian Frances Yates: "There's a great book called the Rosicrucian Enlightenment." The point is that modern science may have grown out of hidden, esoteric traditions.
